title: R17: TLS for inbound peering connections
description: Add TLS support for inbound peering: (1) add [tls] config section with cert_path/key_path; (2) make run_peering_session generic over S: AsyncRead+AsyncWrite+Unpin+Send+'static (same pattern as smtp run_session); (3) in accept_loop in main.rs, if tls configured do rustls accept before calling run_peering_session; (4) outbound TLS deferred: no outbound dialer exists yet. Close kfo.
